svg.title: coil-flat-drop bore - section 8 of 8, bend LDDDDDDDDDDDDD~b, 6 parts on 403x274mm
svg.desc: 1 user unit = 1mm. 10mm square bore in 3mm stock, so a 16mm block pitch; a block that runs straight is 16mm long and a block that turns is a 16mm cube. Blocks 45-59 of the walk, entering on D and leaving on N, a 2x14 block plate laid flat. Two face plates (mirror images) and the side walls; every part carries the section number only. Inner cuts are the port and come before their outline. black #000000 cuts, blue #0000ff engraves.
